extension.summary: Free movies and TV shows from Fawesome (unofficial)
extension.description:
Browse and play Fawesome's free, on-demand catalogue of movies and TV shows: Home, Collections, Shows, Movies, En Español and Handpicked rows, with search, seasons and episodes, and subtitles where Fawesome has them. No account or sign-up -- Fawesome has none.
Streams are plain HLS played through InputStream Adaptive; no DRM module is needed.
Known gaps: Fawesome is ad-supported and its web player requests ads separately from the video (client-side VMAP). This add-on plays the programme stream only and does not insert those ads. The FAST linear channels on Fawesome's TV apps are not included. Fawesome is US-centric; its catalogue may differ or be unavailable elsewhere.
This add-on uses Fawesome's undocumented website API and may need updating when the site changes.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Future Today Inc. Fawesome is a trademark of Future Today Inc.
extension.news: 2026.11.24 - Subtitles labelled by language again - Subtitles are downloaded as language-named files so Kodi shows "English", "Spanish" etc. in the menu and auto-selects your language. Kodi's setSubtitles has no language argument and reads the language only from the filename, and Fawesome's caption URLs carry no language, so a per-play download (a few KB) is the only way to label them. Reverts the URL-only approach from 2026.11.23, which could not be labelled. 2026.11.23 - Subtitles without a download - Subtitles are now handed to Kodi as the caption URLs directly, in preference order (your Kodi language, then English, first), instead of being downloaded first. The one Kodi auto-selects is your preferred language when the title offers it. Fawesome's filenames carry no language, so tracks are unlabelled in the menu but correctly ordered. 2026.11.22 - Subtitle languages and audio label - FIX: subtitles are now labelled by language and offered English (or your Kodi language) first. Before, only the title's own-language caption was attached with no label, so a Spanish or Portuguese title showed its native subtitles with no way to tell or switch. Each available track (the title's own, plus Fawesome's extra Spanish/French ones) is now downloaded as a language-named file so Kodi names them and you can choose. - The single (muxed) audio track is now labelled with the title's language instead of "Unknown". Fawesome's streams carry only one audio track, so there is still nothing to switch between. 2026.11.21 - First test build - Browse Fawesome's sections and rows, open shows by season, search, and play titles (clear HLS through InputStream Adaptive) with subtitles.
